newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell and Lockheed to vie for contract - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell and Lockheed to vie for contract - WSJ.

text.p: McDonnell Douglas Corp and Lockheed Martin Corp will compete for a $1.6 billion Air Force contract to develop new expendable rockets for launching government satellites, The Wall Street Journal reported Monday.

The selection, having eliminated bids by Boeing Co and Alliant Techsystems, pits the two big aerospace companies against each other to snare the final contract, which will provide the winner a big subsidy toward development of a new family of rockets for the separate commercial satellite-launch market, the story said.
